scope: dartflow_private schema and runtime-visible application rows only; not a full Supabase/Auth/managed-service backup

backup.connection: Fixed production project host and dartflow_app account; parsed PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD environment; verify-full with pinned public CA

restoreDrill.target: isolated local PostgreSQL16 scratch database in development fixture; main database untouched

formatAdaptation.description: Only PostgreSQL17 psql restrict markers and transaction_timeout session setting omitted; schema, rows and grants retained

staging.note: Parent deployment task independently promoted staging during this backup; this backup procedure performed no app/service changes.

mutationsPerformed.target: Created only a fresh root-only backup directory and archive; no production schema/config/app/service/provider mutation
mutationsPerformed.development: Created and restored a uniquely named local scratch database, then removed it; preserved the main development database

limitations: Archive excludes Supabase Auth users/sessions, managed schemas, provider configuration, external mail delivery state and cluster roles.
Backup was read with the existing limited application role and --enable-row-security; original production application tables currently contain no profiles, clubs or matches.
A database recovery would not revert Google/SMTP/Resend configuration or external provider events.

The actual restoration used PostgreSQL16; only two PostgreSQL17 psql restrict marker lines and one transaction_timeout session-setting line were omitted. Schema, rows and grant statements were retained.
